# Check if the mean of irregular galaxies is exactly 2.1 greater than the mean of spiral galaxies
# Since the claim says "2.1 more apparent magnitude than", we interpret as irregular_mean = spiral_mean + 2.1
answer = abs(mean_irregular - (mean_spiral + 2.1)) < 1e-10
